proposal.target: stand .env (missing API key for chat service)
proposal.change: Populate the missing API key variable in the stand's .env file so the /chat endpoint can authenticate its model backend, then rerun DIS-006.
proposal.diff_preview:
--- a/stand/.env
+++ b/stand/.env
@@
-# LLM_API_KEY=
+LLM_API_KEY=${LLM_API_KEY}  # injected from CI secret store
proposal.risk: Secret handling: the key must come from the CI secret store, not be committed; a wrong or expired key would keep the 500 in place, and the same key may also affect other daily-gate cases.
